turns.text: Comprehensive brachytherapy question about oropharyngeal_salvage. Role of brachytherapy in salvage for 59-year-old man with 2.0 cm retropharyngeal lymph node recurrence after definitive IMRT 70 Gy for HPV+ oropharyngeal cancer. Include re-irradiation considerations, applicator selection, surgical coordination, dose, and cumulative tolerance.

A 62-year-old man named George has been treated with interstitial brachytherapy for a recurrent squamous cell carcinoma of the oral tongue. He had prior surgery (partial glossectomy) and chemoradiation. The interstitial implant used 6 needles and the treatment was completed uneventfully. He now presents 2 weeks post-treatment with pain, swelling, and purulent discharge from the implant sites. Evaluate his symptoms and design a management plan.
